scope: rag_splitter README and src static analysis; no code execution or network requests

evidence.supports: The learning material frames loaders as a way to turn varied knowledge sources into documents, and describes document content/metadata plus text splitting concepts.
The manual path uses axios to fetch HTML, Cheerio to load it, and the .main-area p selector to extract text.
The LangChain path uses CheerioWebBaseLoader and RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter with chunkSize 400, separators Chinese full stop/question/exclamation marks, and chunkOverlap 100.
Runtime results, dependency versions, target URL availability, and current selector validity are not established.
